- [LDET.1.8.7] **Adapter discovery burst ordering.** A discovery-driven
  adapter enumerates its entities at connect. The
  enumeration order must be spec-committed (alphabetical
  by entity_id, per ADAPTER_CONTRACT) for determinism to
  hold across adapter implementations; given that
  ordering, the burst is deterministic within one
  adapter. Across adapter processes, the recording of
  each fact with its wall-clock timestamp captures what
  the receiving tier observed.
